cards.name: Canton Summer Camp
cards.description: Campers do outdoor crafts, games, themed activities and swimming at Recreation Park. Separate rising-grade groups participate in activities appropriate to their grade bands.

hours.text: Drop off 7:30–8:45am; camp activities begin at 9:00am; pickup 4:00–5:30pm at Recreation Park's basketball courts.

lunch.text: Campers need to bring their own lunch and snacks for the day.
